verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm an llms.txt at developers.deepgram.com that returns HTTP 200 and opens with an explicit "Instructions for AI Agents" section. Every docs page is served as clean Markdown by appending .md, and an openapi.json spec is published, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt full-content dump.
